4. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: 4.1. The applicant must be a citizen of India. 4.2. He/ She should have attained the age of majority i.e., an applicant should have completed 18 years of age as on the last date of registration and legally competent to enter into a contract. 4.3. There shall be no restriction with regard to owning any land/built up property in Delhi, 4.4. The family income of the applicant as well as of joint/co-applicant applying for EWS flats should not exceed Rs. 10 Lakh per annum in case of both the families considered separately. Family Income for this clause is defined to include the income of the applicant and his/her spouse, if married. 4.5 The joint applicant/co-applicant should be from within the family and for this clause. Family means a person or his/her parents or his/her blood relatives or his/her spouse or unmarried children. The applicant (and/or co-applicant) has to produce a valid annual family income certificate /EWS Certificate issued by the competent authority (from the office of concerned SDM/Tehsildar/issuing authority) in this regard issued on or before the last date of registration. 4.6. The applicant should give particulars of his/her savings account in any Bank in the name of the applicant only in the ‘Application Form’. 4.7. Applicant must have Permanent Account Number (PAN) allotted under the provisions of the Income Tax Act and the same must be quoted in the Application Form. 4.8. In case of joint applicant under SC/ST Reserved Category, the joint applicant should be from within the Family. Family for this clause means a person or his/her parents or his/her blood relatives or his/her spouse or unmarried children 4.9. In case of joint application under Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (Divyangjan), ex-servicemen reserved categories, the applicant himself/herself should fall within the reserved category and the joint applicant/co-applicant should be from within the Family. Family for this clause means a person or his/her parents or his/her blood relatives or his/her spouse or unmarried children 4.10. It is advisable that co-allottee, if any, may preferably be added at the application stage rather than at later stage, for easy processing. 5. Allotment Process All the eligible applicants shall be considered for allotment through a computerized draw based on random number technique. The draw shall be conducted in online mode in a transparent manner in the presence of independent observers along with presence of sample number of applicants, say 20. In case excess flats remain un-allotted, DDA will again call for applications from eligible applicants and another draw for such flats shall be conducted by DDA. The draw for this Housing Scheme will be web-streamed. Page 2 of 3

records.title: Allotment of Car Parking Spaces to Allottees of DDA Karmayogi Awaas Yojana 2025 and DDA Nagrik Awaas Yojana 2026

pages.text: fecett facre virco STG (Ada) RIG facta act, sates — Sh, fore er, Ag facet F4(Misc)2026/Coordn(H)/DDA | 434.5 Date | goa 2026 Circular Allotment of Car Parking Spaces to Allottees of DDA Karmayogi Awaas Yojana 2025 and DDA Naagrik Awaas Yojana 2026 It is hereby informed that HIG/3 BHK and MIG/2 BHK allottees of DDA Karmayogi Awaas Yojana 2025 and DDA Naagrik Awaas Yojana 2026 are invited to submit their requests for allotment of car parking space(s), along with their preference for car parking space(s) , from amongst the available parking spaces in their respective housing pockets. 2. The allotment of parking spaces shall be carried out on a monthly basis. The last working day of each month shall be considered as the cut-off date for determining the priority of eligible allottees for the respective round of allotment. An eligible allottee who does not submit his/her request during the current round may submit the request in a subsequent month and shall be considered for allotment in that round only. 3. Priority for allotment of parking spaces shall be determined on the basis of the date of issuance of the Demand-cum-Allotment Letter (DAL), subject to the issuance of the Possession Letter and availability of the requested parking space(s), with earlier issuance of DAL being accorded higher priority. In case of the same DAL date, priority shall be determined on the basis of the earlier date of booking/allotment of the flat and, where the same, by the earlier time of booking. 4. The number of parking spaces to be allotted to an allottee shall be as specified in the brochure/Demand-cum-Allotment Letter of the concerned scheme/flat. However, not more than one parking space shall be allotted at the stilt level to any allottee. In case an allottee is eligible for two parking spaces, he/she may give preference for one stilt-level parking space and one upper/lower basement parking space. Allotment as per the preference shall be subject to availability. 5. Applications for allotment of parking space(s), along with the prescribed documents, may be submitted to: DD Coordination (Housing) Room No. 215, 2nd Floor, D-Block Vikas Sadan, INA, New Delhi-110023 6. The application shall be submitted along with the following documents: (i) Copy of Demand-cum-Allotment Letter (DAL); (ii) Copy of Possession Letter; (iii) Copy of allottee’s ID proof; and (iv) Details/preferences of the parking space(s) sought, including preference for 1 stilt-level and 1 basement-level parking. This issues with the approval of the Competent Authority. Dy. Director Coordination (Hotsing)
